plugins.description: atlias. A sub-harness that links itself to Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Gemini CLI the moment a session opens: one shared memory with layered history and Dream consolidation, a graphify knowledge graph that answers codebase questions first, a cache-stable session brief, a repeated-call and destructive-command guard, a syntax and two-pass verification gate, compaction handoff notes, and companion routing to Ultimate Frontend Skills.
